summary.group9_accessibility: 3/4 PASS, 1 REVIEW REQUIRED (physical screen reader NVDA/TalkBack)

gates.requirement: Studio shell splits into editor pane (left) and live phone simulator (right) on desktop viewports (>=1024px)
gates.notes: Verified at 1440px and 1920px desktop viewports. Flex row layout with resizable split divider.

gates.requirement: Split pane divider supports pointer drag with smooth percentage resizing clamped between 30% and 75%
gates.notes: Verified clamp logic: 10% clamps to 30%, 95% clamps to 75%, NaN gracefully defaults to 60%.

gates.requirement: Tablet viewport (768px-1023px) stacks or collapses preview into tabbed mode or accessible preview button
gates.notes: Verified on 768px tablet width. Editor pane takes full width, preview opened via toolbar Eye action.

gates.requirement: Mobile viewport (<768px) displays full-screen section editor with sticky bottom action bar and preview sheet
gates.notes: Verified on 393px iPhone viewport. Preview opens in full-screen slide-over sheet with close trigger.

gates.requirement: Ultra-narrow viewport (320px) preserves touch targets (>=44x44px) without horizontal scrollbar on body
gates.evidenceRef: StudioChrome.css max-width 360px rules, Playwright screenshot 11 & 12, N13-16 test
gates.notes: Verified no overflow on 320px SE/Galaxy Fold narrow widths.

gates.requirement: Mobile landscape mode (e.g. 844x390) renders compact toolbar (<=54px height) to maximize editing area
gates.evidenceRef: StudioChrome.css lines 538-550, Playwright screenshot 13 & 14, N13-15 test
gates.notes: Verified 54px toolbar height and 15px title under landscape media query.

gates.requirement: Studio navigation renders canonical section tabs (Event Info, Schedule, Family, Map, Gallery, Story, Notes)
gates.notes: All 10 canonical section tabs render with bilingual labels in EN and KM.

gates.requirement: Section tabs support keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End)
gates.notes: W3C ARIA Tab pattern fully implemented and verified with Vitest fireEvent.

gates.requirement: Mobile section selector dropdown provides instant section jumping with visible section icon badges
gates.notes: Syncs bidirectionally with active tab state.

gates.requirement: Active section state synchronizes with URL query param ?tab=<section> for deep linking without full reload
gates.notes: Navigating tabs updates search params without mounting new DOM instances.

gates.requirement: Sections can be toggled enabled/disabled with instant live simulator feedback
gates.notes: Disabled sections omit their respective blocks from preview postMessage state.

gates.requirement: Template-specific disabled sections (e.g. story disabled in minimal template) display disabled badges
gates.notes: Truthfully reflects template capabilities from registry.

gates.requirement: useStudioPersistence debounces autosave at 1500ms after last keystroke
gates.notes: Timer resets on every keystroke, flushes automatically after 1500ms idle.

gates.requirement: Save state badge displays truthful phases: Saved, Saving, Unsaved, Offline, Conflict, Session Expired
gates.notes: Verified for all 6 states with bilingual strings and role=status polite announcement.

gates.requirement: Ctrl+S / Cmd+S manual save triggers immediate persistence flush without waiting for debounce timer
gates.notes: preventDefault halts browser bookmark dialog and dispatches studio.flush().

gates.requirement: Document-level Undo/Redo (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+Y) restores previous snapshots when not in text input
gates.notes: Verified text inputs keep native undo; document canvas executes snapshot undo.

gates.requirement: Navigation guard intercepts tab close and React Router navigation when dirty state exists
gates.notes: beforeunload and navigator method proxies prompt user before leaving unsaved work.

gates.requirement: HTTP 409 Conflict leaves local unsaved edits intact and prompts user to review newer server version
gates.notes: Sets phase to 'conflict', suspends auto-writes, prevents silent overwrites.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Cover photo, background, and gallery images accept valid image files (JPG, PNG, WebP) up to 10MB
gates.notes: Format constraints and size limits enforced client-side.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Local image selection creates temporary object URL for instant live simulator preview before server upload
gates.notes: URL.createObjectURL provides zero-latency preview.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Object URLs are tracked and cleanly revoked (URL.revokeObjectURL) when replaced or component unmounts
gates.notes: Prevents memory leaks during heavy image editing sessions.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Strip inline base64/blob media references from persisted JSON payload to prevent database bloat
gates.notes: Replaces transient blob URLs with canonical server media URLs upon save.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Template decorative artwork (e.g. Silk Heritage kbach borders) preserved and not overwritten by user cover
gates.notes: Explicit test confirms silk-heritage decorative assets remain intact.

gates.category: Media Handling, Local Blobs & Upload Safety
gates.requirement: Direct Cloudinary CDN upload streaming with signature validation
gates.evidenceRef: Scoped to Phase 14.1 Gemini Media Studio
gates.notes: Phase 13 binds URLs and staging blobs. Full signed CDN upload pipeline belongs to Phase 14.1.

gates.requirement: Studio chrome supports instant language toggle between Khmer (KM) and English (EN)
gates.notes: Tested in both EN and KM viewports across all Playwright runs.

gates.requirement: Khmer typography renders with Hanuman / Moul / Battambang / Kantumruy Pro with appropriate line-height (>=1.6)
gates.evidenceRef: StudioChrome.css, StudioFontPreview.test.jsx, font loader in TemplateExperience.jsx
gates.notes: Khmer fonts applied with generous line-height to prevent subscript vowel clipping.

gates.requirement: Khmer complex Unicode subscripts (Coeng U+17D2) and diacritics handle input without truncation or corruption
gates.notes: Verified with multi-character Khmer wedding phrases (e.g. ពិធីមង្គលការ, សិរីសួស្តី).

gates.requirement: Bilingual invitation authoring allows maintaining distinct KM and EN text sets within localizedContentV1
gates.notes: Preserves both versions; switching language tabs does not drop unselected language text.

gates.requirement: 'Copy names from Khmer' utility conveniently populates English partner names without retyping
gates.notes: Copies groom, bride, and host names into English schema.

gates.requirement: Cultural linguist formal review of all Khmer instructional microcopy and wedding phrasing
gates.notes: Microcopy is natural Khmer, but formal cultural sign-off requires native wedding linguist.

gates.requirement: Illustrated map editor modal launches from venue section with interactive landmark placing
gates.notes: Modal mounts cleanly and supports bilingual landmark search.

gates.requirement: Landmarks include Cambodian wedding icons (wedding hall, pagoda, parking, bridge, roundabout)
gates.notes: Icons categorized into venue, travel, and ceremonial points of interest.

gates.requirement: Roads, intersections, and labels can be edited and manipulated via keyboard (Arrow keys, Enter, Esc)
gates.notes: Full keyboard positioning and labeling verified.

gates.requirement: Map designer confirms before replacing an existing non-empty design to prevent accidental loss
gates.notes: Prompts confirmation modal if canvas has existing roads or pins.

gates.requirement: Generated sketch map image compiles into sketchMapImage payload URL/data
gates.notes: Persisted in both designJson and contentJson.

gates.requirement: Map designer disables cleanly for templates that use photo backgrounds instead of vector maps (e.g. Floral)
gates.notes: Respects template capabilities and prevents irrelevant tooling display.

gates.requirement: Template chooser modal renders all 10 canonical templates with live thumbnails and tier badges
gates.evidenceRef: TemplateChooser.jsx, TemplateChooser.test.jsx (4 tests passed), Playwright screenshot 15
gates.notes: Displays FREE, ESSENTIAL, and VIP tier badges.

gates.requirement: Switching templates preserves all authored data (couple names, schedule, media, unknown JSON keys)
gates.notes: Data payload is retained; only templateCode and templateId switch.

gates.requirement: Premium templates require active entitlement; unauthorized users are prompted to upgrade/pay
gates.notes: Never presents active Select button for premium template if unpurchased.

gates.requirement: Template search and category filtering (Classic, Modern, Floral, Royal, Minimal) filter accurately
gates.notes: Instant filtering without re-rendering editor shell.

gates.requirement: Fallback renderer loads safely when an unknown or legacy templateCode is encountered
gates.notes: Gracefully defaults to Khmer Celestial without throwing unhandled exceptions.

gates.requirement: Pre-wedding video editor accepts YouTube and Vimeo links with canonical ID extraction
gates.notes: Parses standard watch, short, and embed YouTube URLs.

gates.requirement: Video embed URL sanitization rejects invalid video schemas or dangerous iframe injections
gates.notes: Prevents XSS via javascript: or unapproved domains.

gates.requirement: Background music track selection allows choosing from royalty-free Cambodian wedding instrumentals
gates.notes: Includes standard tracks like 'ថ្ងៃដែលរង់ចាំ' and violins.

gates.requirement: Custom music MP3/M4A URL binding supports external audio assets
gates.notes: Binds URL to audio element in preview simulator.

gates.requirement: Real-time audio waveform visualizer and scrubber
gates.evidenceRef: Scoped to Phase 14.1 Gemini Media Studio
gates.notes: Audio playback works; rich canvas waveform visualization belongs to Phase 14.1.

gates.requirement: Color contrast ratios for all Studio chrome text and icons meet or exceed 4.5:1 (normal) / 3:1 (large)
gates.notes: Deep forest green text on light cream/gray exceeds WCAG AAA.

gates.requirement: All interactive buttons and links feature visible :focus-visible outlines with 2px offset
gates.notes: High-contrast emerald focus ring applied to all controls.

gates.requirement: Save state announcements use aria-live='polite' and role='status' without interrupting active screen reader speech
gates.notes: Polite announcement ensures non-intrusive status delivery.

gates.requirement: Full screen reader validation on physical Windows NVDA and Android TalkBack
gates.evidenceRef: Hardware and OS physical testing requirement
gates.notes: DOM semantic tree and ARIA roles verified; physical screen reader session recommended before production.

gates.requirement: Studio code chunk is lazy-loaded; does not bloat initial guest-facing bundle
gates.evidenceRef: Vite production build output: InvitationStudio chunk is 47.35 kB (14.08 kB gzip)
gates.notes: Lazy route code-splitting verified; guest invitation routes remain lean.

gates.requirement: Zero external npm dependencies added; pure native React 19 hooks and CSS variables
gates.notes: Verified package.json unmodified.

gates.requirement: All Vitest unit, component, and negative tests pass cleanly with 0 failures
gates.evidenceRef: frontend-user: 1,821 passed; frontend-admin: 202 passed; studio: 106 passed; negative: 38 passed
gates.notes: 100% test pass rate across all test suites.

gates.requirement: Production Vite build passes without syntax errors, missing asset references, or type warnings
gates.evidenceRef: npm run build in apps/frontend-user (1.90s) & apps/frontend-admin (670ms)
gates.notes: Both applications build cleanly with exit code 0.
